Task: Batch Speech-to-Text

Write Python code that returns word or segment timestamps from a transcription result using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
from google.cloud import speech_v1

def batch_speech_to_text(audio_file_path, bucket_name):
    speech_client = speech_v1.SpeechClient()
    uri = f"gs://{bucket_name}/{audio_file_path}"
    
    config = speech_v1.RecognitionConfig(
        encoding=speech_v1.RecognitionConfig.AudioEncoding.LINEAR16,
        sample_rate_hertz=16000,
        language_code="en-US"
    )
    audio = speech_v1.RecognitionAudio(uri=uri)
    
    operation = speech_client.long_running_recognize(config=config, audio=audio)
    
    result = operation.result(timeout=420)
    
    return [{
        "word": result.alternatives[0].words[i].word,
        "start_time_seconds": result.alternatives[0].words[i].start_time.seconds +
                              result.alternatives[0].words[i].start_time.nanos / 1e9,
        "end_time_seconds": result.alternatives[0].words[i].end_time.seconds +
                            result.alternatives[0].words[i].end_time.nanos / 1e9
    } for i in range(len(result.alternatives[0].words))]
